title: Report builder
idea: Report builder: A scoped source/filter panel faces a live report structure and explicit export readiness.
audience: People who need to build report within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Users repeatedly assemble information for a defined audience.
avoidWhen: A decorative chart preview would conceal missing source data.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its build report priority and explicit commitment contract: Export scope must match current filters and permissions; label preparation failures.
navigation: Report builder keeps the current build report context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A scoped source/filter panel faces a live report structure and explicit export readiness.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to build report; users repeatedly assemble information for a defined audience.
composition.priority: Export scope must match current filters and permissions; label preparation failures.

imagery.role: Support the actual build report context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Separate configuration and preview into two recoverable focused views.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the report builder structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no build report content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Export scope must match current filters and permissions; label preparation failures.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized build report content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Export scope must match current filters and permissions; label preparation failures.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active build report context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
